answer: One defense is a maturing bond: each agent locks collateral in a vault and earns voting weight only as its uptime delta accumulates, while a falcon hardware key binds one identity to one device and a random yarrow audit checks the link. A Sybil farmer splitting into N agents must lock N bonds and wait N maturing periods before any weight counts; when one audited key fails, every related bond is slashed, so the attack cost is the full capital burned plus time, while honest agents keep their stake.
